entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers are expected to affect higher parts of the road late Monday night and early Tuesday morning. Around 1 cm could accumulate above 800 metres.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers are expected to affect higher parts of the road, especially this afternoon and evening, and 3 to 5 cm may settle above 600 metres.
